## Où j'en suis
Built the v2 dashboard grid using react-grid-layout, wiring server-side layout persistence with an offline localStorage fallback. Switched from container queries to a ResizeObserver hook to fix iOS 15 Safari sizing. Renamed components, fixed Storybook CI, and opened draft PR #418 ahead of the Zest demo.

- [en-cours] Draft PR #418 awaiting Priya's UX review on iPad
- [prochaine-étape] Enable dashboards_v2 flag for the Zest workspace in admin config
- [essai-raté] Container queries dropped after failing to render widgets on iOS 15 Safari
- [décision] Persist layout server-side via PUT (source: t03) • Drop container queries for ResizeObserver sizing (source: t09) • Keep v1 dashboards untouched until January (source: t15) • Open draft PR for review (source: t17)
